opus.problem: Naming Ruth gives the word away. The man in Ruth's harvest field who orders his young men to leave her stalks can only be Boaz. Replace 'Ruth' with something like 'a Moabite gleaner'.

Naming Ruth makes this nearly a giveaway. Also, the reason 'so she would not return to Naomi empty-handed' is not in Ruth 3:15. It comes from Ruth 3:17, so the clue is not fully true to its cited verse.
This gives the word away. Naming Rahab as mother, Obed as son and Ruth as wife in one clue leaves no doubt. Drop some of these names, for example keep only 'his mother was Rahab'.
